await (async (page) => { const routes=['/','/year/','/1953/','/1930/','/1975/','/your-year/','/gifts/','/1950s-life/','/kitchen/','/sources/','/about/','/privacy.html','/terms.html','/family/','/thanks/','/404.html','/01/','/privacy/','/terms/','/accessibility/'];const results=[];for(const route of routes){const r=await page.request.get('http://127.0.0.1:8115'+route);await page.locator('.CodeMirror').first().evaluate((el,v)=>el.CodeMirror.setValue(v),await r.text());await page.locator('#validate-button').click();await page.waitForTimeout(700);results.push({route,text:await page.locator('#results-cell').innerText()});}return results; })(page);
